_readme: Camera profiles for 'build around a camera'. mount = native mount(s); adapters = lens mounts usable via an adapter; format = FF | S35 | MFT | MF | 2/3 | 1in | 16; media / battery = families matched by name patterns in js/compat.js; kit = key into kits. Edit freely — ids are Utopia product ids, match is a fallback regex on the product name. sensor = the sensor area a camera actually uses for UHD 16:9 recording (w × h mm, the mode, and the source it was verified against). Cameras without it are not offered in the lens tool. year = the year the maker announced the camera (lists show the newest first). sensor.modes = recording formats, each its own sensor window (first = default).

sensor.src: Sony FX6 manual (Help Guide PDF, p.12): in FF, cropping only at UHD 100/120 fps S&Q or RAW UHD — regular UHD uses the full width. p.161: 35 mm full-frame, 10.2M effective (16:9). Sony does not publish the width in mm; 35.6 mm is the official FX3 figure for the same 12.9M sensor.
